requirement: At least one public real LiDAR data source for supplementary external validation
required_evidence: public dataset citation, immutable release identity, and selected-dataset declaration

requirement: Reference trajectory backbone independent of evaluated query-to-target scan-to-map registration; no ICP, scan matching, LiDAR odometry, or SLAM; historical LiDAR-assisted static extrinsic allowed only under all ten documented limitations
required_evidence: trajectory provenance and complete fixed-extrinsic provenance

requirement: Evaluated query scan is not used to construct its own target map
required_evidence: frozen query and target-map construction lineage

requirement: Target map and query scan come from different Boreas sequences
Timestamp and extrinsic chains are auditable while unknown numeric error bounds remain unknown
required_evidence: timestamp provenance, calibration provenance, and transform chain

requirement: Future successful Stage-2 design freezes 10 weak intervals x 5 snapshots and 10 rich intervals x 5 snapshots: 50 weak, 50 rich, 100 total, 200 backend trials; current Stage-1 counts remain zero
Every weak/rich label is frozen before any real registration is run
required_evidence: immutable pre-registration interval and label manifest

requirement: Open3D and PCL consume byte-identical canonical input
Existing frozen Open3D/PCL backend parameter contract is retained without Boreas-specific ICP parameters
Record trajectory position RMSE plus orientation, time-sync, extrinsic, interpolation, deskew, and map-accumulation uncertainty; UNKNOWN is never zero
Boreas v2 is not the primary metrological gate and small/comparable updates are only descriptive registration updates
Continuous displacement, rotation, and association metrics are primary and cannot be replaced by one arbitrary success threshold
Association and reassociation reuse the frozen offline common-association definition
Primary pair, reserve pairs, intervals, weak/rich labels, and snapshots cannot be reselected after registration results are observed
